blocks.text: Apartments, community centres and a pink outdoor toilet: Australia’s 2026 National Architecture award winners – in pictures
Chosen from a shortlist of more than 60 projects , the winners of this year’s Australian Institute of Architects’ annual awards were praised for their ‘architectural ambition and community benefit’

blocks.text: Emil Sodersten award for interior architecture
Studio8, Partners Hill (Victoria) An apartment in what was originally a basement laundry within the heritage-listed Quamby building in Toorak,

t he site presented an unlikely environment for a home, involving exposed footings, presence of damp/wet interiors, minute scale and access via steep terrain. The project’s use of recycled materials, multi-purpose spaces and strategies to enlarge perception of the tiny site, it acts as a template for ‘unlocking’ underutilised housing stock in Australian cities.Photograph: Tom Ross
